referenceInput.provenance: 太阳能规则表2初赛10次顺序访问，保留首尾地球；用户确认平推。用户确认传动比35且程序不得自动修改；其余机械尺寸、90度初始航向、零初始转角及阈值沿用历史测试配置，未实测。计算从传感器位于首个地球中心开始，不含实际发车引入段；末点为再次经过地球，不要求航向周期闭合。

sourceHashScope: Delivered source files. Numerical core frozen throughout formal runs; report/recovery fixes made during execution did not change numerical objectives, constraints or candidates.
coreContracts: partition of unity, analytic D1-D3, scalar/endpoints, Bernstein oracle and knot joins
exact quadratic/cubic polynomial conversion, derivatives, route integration and explicit count refit
formal solar geometry converts with measured fit error and 66 effective variables
legacy objective/bounds default retained; explicit regularizer and trajectory-only policy keep physical constraints
real short inner-point solves and callbacks preserve B3/B5/Bezier endpoint equalities and effective DOF
unsupported backends rejected, old peak-search path retained and B-spline MAT roundtrip exact
uiContracts: real model/apply/calculate callbacks convert B3, select inner-point and display actual coefficient controls
B5 model callback and actual optimize button run the endpoint-constrained backend without changing ratio or parameters
actual add/delete controls refit, synchronize density and preserve derivatives; map editing accepts free controls and rejects endpoint violations
unsupported peak/four-direction/auto modes disable optimize and explicit action rejects them without model replacement
same save/import action branches as toolbar preserve knots, controls, constraints, settings and route model
fixed-cam simulation accepts trial heading and restores the complete constrained B-spline design on exit
rebuild retains explicit B5/count and switching back to cubic samples the real curve
legacy independent Bezier model/apply path remains functional after B-spline integration
visible out-of-field B-spline coefficient can be clicked, dragged and confirmed; finite/visible/source guards remain and physical bounds still fail
legacy-bound B-spline, cubic and independent Bezier retain field-limited map editing
